title: WaitForSignal
body:
Gabriel: Same plan. Draw the guards away, we go in, and follow the map to the server room.
Hana: Same map huh...
Gabriel: Yep I guess it's more efficient this way.
<<signal>>
[Gabriel signals]
The plan is set into motion.

title: Crash
body: Explosions reverberate across the bridge. Officers rush to investigate.

title: Race
body: Hana coughs, unable to catch up to Gabriel

title: Erupt
body: Explosions erupt before Hana is clear.

title: Still
body: Hana was unable to escape. Hana blacks out...

title: Carry
body: Gabriel carries the downed Hana back to the bunker...
